title: Cutting Formation
description: Massively bedded, fine grained gray dolostone

title: Bascom Formation
description: Inter-layered gray limestone and rusty brown weathering dolomite; gray limestone, and dolostone with layers of calcareous quartzite. In outcrop, the then (0.1 -0.5 cm) dolomite commonly weathers as ribs

title: Skeels Corner Formation
description: Dark gray to gray phyllite and laminated slate with thin (1-5mm) orange-brown weathering dolomite layers

title: Skeels Corner Formation
description: Gray to black weakly graphitic slate/phyllite and gray slate with thin (1-5mm) brown dolomite layers; interbedded limestone, dolostone and phyllite

title: Clarendon Springs Formation
description: Light to dark gray, massive, granular, recrystallized dolostone and breccia with chert and dolostone clasts

title: Danby Formation
description: Fine to medium grained, gray dolomitic sandstone, commonly with visible rounded gray quartz sand grains

title: Dunham Formation
description: Tan to brown weathering, buff to light gray, massively bedded dolostone

title: Cheshire Formation
description: Light to dark gray, massive, fine to medium grained quartzite and dark gray argillaceous quartzite

title: Fairfield Pond Formation
description: Tan weathering, thinly foliated to massive, grayish-green to gray quartz-sericite-chlorite phyllitic granofels and phyllite. Cleavage planes may have a pearly sheen. Massive gray granular quartzite and blue quartz pebble conglomerate occurs as layers. Quartz and quartz-calcite veins are common. Contact with overlying Cc is gradational

title: Pinnacle Formation
description: Gray to greenish-gray quartz-plagioclase-chlorite-sericite +/- magnetite and pyrite phyllitic granofels, pinstriped schist and quartz-pebble conglomerate. Quartz veins and quartz-sulfide veins commonly occur parallel to the dominant foliation. Contact with overlying CZfp is gradational

title: Pinnacle Formation
description: Light gray weathering, fine to coarse-grained, massive quartz pebble conglomerate commonly studded with smoky gray rounded quartz pebbles +/- pyrite and magnetite
